item.description:
• Updates now finish properly: Kit comes back on the new version instead of offering you the same update again.
  • The Kit panel loads reliably after an update.
  • Claude Desktop and Claude Code now connect on every new install: the connector ships ready to run.
  • An update that stalls partway now finishes itself on Kit's next check-in.
  • When a dream or background task fails, Kit records what happened so it can be diagnosed for you, no screenshots needed.
  • Channel chat history loads from the right place again.
  • Opening a task from Studio brings up that task, not an empty dialog.
  • Tidying behind the scenes: retired unused machinery and a refreshed test suite.
